backups.intro: Backup events: pick an instance, credential and the databases to back up; run now or (soon) schedule it.
backups.name: Name
backups.credentialHint: Leave on “Use the instance's” unless you want a different user for this event.
backups.environmentHint: Taken from the instance; must match the credential's.
backups.environmentMismatch: Mismatch: the instance is “{{server}}” and the credential “{{cred}}”. They must be the same environment.
backups.destinationLocalHint: The “Local” method stores to the default local storage (configurable in Settings).
backups.noDatabases: Click “Discover” to list the instance's databases.
backups.excludeTablesHint: Optional. Comma-separated; skipped from the dump (--exclude-table).
backups.excludeCollectionsHint: Optional. One rule per line; * is a wildcard (e.g. *_old, *_bak, tmp_*). Prefix with "db." to limit it to one database (sales.*_bk). New matching collections are excluded too. Each run's log lists the excluded ones.
backups.excludeCollectionsCaseSensitiveHint: Off: *_bak excludes x_bak and X_BAK. On: only x_bak, and a hand-picked collection (Users) does not also exclude one that differs only in case (users).
backups.collectionsAllExcluded: The rules exclude every collection in this database: the backup will fail rather than produce an empty file.
backups.excludeSchemasHint: Optional. Check the schemas you do NOT want to back up in each database; everything else, including schemas created later, is backed up (--exclude-schema).
backups.excludeExtensionsHint: Excluding an extension that tables or columns depend on (e.g. postgis, citext, uuid-ossp, hstore) will make the restore fail. Only exclude extensions without objects used by the database, such as pgaudit. Requires pg_dump 17 or later (--exclude-extension).
backups.excludeEventTriggersHint: Their CREATE, ALTER and COMMENT ON EVENT TRIGGER statements are removed from the dump (the RETURNS event_trigger function is kept). Useful to restore with a non-superuser, as on Cloud SQL, where creating event triggers fails with "Must be superuser".
backups.compressHint: If disabled, the dump is saved as plain .sql.
backups.cleanDefinersHint: Removes DEFINER from the dump to restore on Cloud SQL or another server.
backups.pgCompatHint: Strips SET transaction_timeout and \restrict/\unrestrict emitted by pg_dump 17+, to restore on PostgreSQL 16 or older (e.g. Cloud SQL import). Data is not altered.
backups.verboseHint: Adds --verbose to the engine and shows its live output (console) during the run. Useful for diagnostics; produces a lot of output on large databases.
backups.keepLocalCopyHint: After uploading and verifying it in the bucket, the dump also stays in the local destination. Retention does not clean these copies: delete them manually or the disk will fill up.
backups.sqlBackupDirHint: SQL Server writes the .bak to this path on the server itself (the SQL service must be able to write there). Not downloaded/uploaded; size/integrity are read from the server.
backups.retentionHint: Automatically deletes old backups from disk. A backup is purged if it exceeds the maximum age OR falls outside the most recent N of its own database. Leave both blank to use the default retention in Settings.
backups.retentionLocalCopyNote: With a local copy, retention deletes only the copy on disk; the bucket backup is kept.
backups.retentionInvalid: Retention must be a whole number greater than or equal to 1.
backups.retentionSqlNote: SQL Server: the .bak stays on the instance host; retention does not delete it automatically.
backups.runQueued: Execution created for “{{name}}”. Check it under Executions.
backups.bucketRequired: The gcloud method requires a destination bucket.
backups.methodCloudSqlExportHint: The Cloud SQL instance itself writes a FULL copy-only .bak to the bucket; no database credential is used. The instance's service account needs roles/storage.objectCreator on the bucket.
backups.retentionBucketNote: The app never deletes backups from buckets: retention only applies to local storage. Use the bucket lifecycle rules in GCS to clean it up.
backups.methodParallelHint: pg_dump -Fd -j N on a new temporary GCE disk created and deleted on every run; the folder is uploaded to the bucket and verified. For AlloyDB and large databases.
backups.parallelJobsHint: Empty = {{suggested}} (vCPU − 2, max 14; this machine has {{vcpus}} vCPU). Opens {{conns}} database connections during the dump. Compression runs on this VM: more workers, more CPU.
backups.noPrivilegesHint: By default the backup keeps privileges on schemas, tables, sequences and functions, like the current script.
backups.noPrivilegesWarning: The backup will not include privileges (pg_dump --no-privileges). After restoring, no user or role will have access to the objects until GRANTs are issued manually. Use it when restoring on another instance where those roles do not exist.
backups.diskSizeHint: Empty = automatic: last successful backup + margin (at least {{def}} GB). Max {{max}} GB (Settings → Temporary disk).
backups.maxHoursHint: Empty = 12 h. Cap: {{max}} h (Settings → Backups). When exceeded the dump stops and the disk is released.
backups.stderrIgnoreHint: One pattern per line (literal text). pg_dump lines containing it are neither shown nor stored. Max {{lines}} lines of {{len}} characters.
backups.excludeEventTriggersParallelHint: With the parallel dump, event triggers cannot be removed from the dump: they are marked as skipped in restore.list; restore with pg_restore -L restore.list.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.cronHint: Format: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week (e.g. 0 21 * * *). Separate several with | (e.g. 1st and 3rd Sunday: 0 2 * * 0#1 | 0 2 * * 0#3).

groups.intro: Group events to schedule or launch them together. Each event runs as its own execution: Cloud SQL exports of different instances run in parallel and dumps wait their turn based on the concurrent dump limit.
groups.name: Name
groups.activeHint: An inactive group is not fired by its schedule; it can still be launched manually.
groups.notifyModeHint: When the group finishes, a summary with each event's status is always sent (subject to the success/failure options in Settings).
groups.confirmRun: Launch the {{count}} events of group «{{name}}» now?
groups.confirmDelete: Delete group «{{name}}»? The events are not deleted.
groups.orderHint: Queue order. Cloud SQL exports are always queued first.
groups.noEvents: No events in the group yet.
groups.sameInstance: Several events on the same instance ({{names}}) run one after another; prefer a single event with all its databases.
groups.overlap: Same time as: {{names}}. Shared events will run twice in a row.

executions.codeHint: Run code: shown in the email subject and in Telegram alerts.
executions.checksumHelp: Fingerprints of the file as it was generated. After downloading, hash your copy and compare: if it matches, the file is identical to the original. SHA-256 is computed by DBKeeper; MD5 and CRC32C are reported by the bucket.
executions.verifyHelpLocal: Rereads the file from disk and compares its SHA-256 with the one recorded when it was generated.
executions.verifyHelpGcs: Quick: compares the object metadata in the bucket (no download). Deep: downloads the object and recomputes its fingerprint (uses GCS egress on large files).
executions.verifyAlert: Integrity compromised: the file changed or no longer exists
executions.cancelRunningConfirm: Cancel "{{name}}"? The running dump or upload stops and the temporary disk is released. Databases already uploaded are kept.
executions.cancelPendingConfirm: Cancel "{{name}}"? It is still queued and will not run.
executions.copyDirCommand: Copy command to download the folder
executions.verifyHelpDir: Folder backup: manifest.json is re-read (its fingerprint must match) and each file size and CRC32C in the bucket is compared, without downloading the data.

servers.title: Instances
servers.name: Name
servers.gcpProjectEmpty: The catalog has no projects. Add them under GCP projects.
servers.credentialHint: Pick a credential from the catalog. You can assign it later.
servers.environmentHint: Environments are managed in the Environments module.
servers.cloudSqlSaHint: Allow the instance to write to the destination bucket:
servers.cloudSqlSaveFirst: Save the instance to test the Cloud SQL connection.
servers.connStringHint: Paste the string Atlas gives you (or mongodb://…) and click Apply: it fills in the type, host and options. The password is not stored here: it goes in Credentials.
servers.connUserDetected: Detected user: {{user}}; create or pick a credential with that user.
servers.connPasswordDiscarded: The password in the string was discarded.
servers.connOptionsHint: Optional. Format key=value&key=value. Supported: authSource, replicaSet, readPreference, appName, retryWrites, w, tls, directConnection.
servers.connSrvDefaults: SRV uses TLS and, unless you set readPreference, {{readPreference}} (reads from a secondary to spare the primary).
servers.platformAlloyDbHint: AlloyDB: new events suggest the parallel dump with its noise filter.
servers.cloudSqlMethodHint: Marking it as Cloud SQL does not change the backup method: each event chooses dump or, on SQL Server, export.

environments.intro: Catalog of environments to classify instances (used in the backup file name).
environments.name: Name
environments.codeHint: Short code (PRD, UAT, DEV…); used in the backup file name.

gcpProjects.intro: Catalog of GCP projects available for Cloud SQL and AlloyDB instances.
gcpProjects.projectIdHint: The GCP ID (not the name or number), e.g. my-project-prd.
gcpProjects.name: Name

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.intro: Reusable backup users. Define a credential once and assign it to multiple instances.
credentials.name: Name
credentials.extraHint: Optional. Encrypted JSON (e.g. GCP service account key).
credentials.extraHintKeep: Extra data is stored. Leave empty to keep it.
credentials.extraInvalid: Extra data JSON is not valid.

storage.intro: Storage targets for backups: a local folder or a cloud bucket. Mark one default per type.
storage.name: Name
storage.pathHint: Server folder where dumps are stored. Relative paths resolve from the API.
storage.serviceAccountHint: Paste the GCP service account JSON. Leave empty to keep current.
storage.accountHint: Account from the catalog used to authenticate against the bucket.

cloud.intro: Reusable cloud service accounts (key/credential) to authenticate and operate (upload to buckets, etc.).
cloud.name: Name
cloud.secretHint: Paste the service account JSON that GCP provides. Stored encrypted.
cloud.secretHintEdit: Leave empty to keep the current credential.
cloud.computeDetected: DBKeeper runs on a Compute Engine VM with the service account
cloud.computeScopesWarn: The VM access scopes don't allow: {{missing}}. It will fail even if the account has the IAM roles. Change the VM scopes to cloud-platform (requires stopping it).
cloud.computeAdded: Already in the catalog: you can pick it in Storage and Instances.
cloud.computeAddHint: Adds it to the catalog without a key; it authenticates with the VM identity.
cloud.computeNoKey: VM account (Compute Engine): no key is used, the VM itself provides the identity. Grant permissions to that account through IAM.

settings.title: Settings
settings.appearanceHint: Color palette and mode. Saved to your user and follows you on any device.
settings.storageDefaultsHint: Target used when an event doesn't specify one (local for dumps; bucket for cloud).
settings.apiTitleHint: API title field (required). Also used as sender name when the from has none (from: Name <email>).
settings.ldapSecurityNoneWarn: Unencrypted, every login password travels in plain text over the network. Use it only if the domain controller supports neither StartTLS nor LDAPS.
settings.ldapSearchBaseOptional: Optional: if set, the user's name and email are read at login.
settings.ldapTestHint: Validates a user and password with the saved settings. The password is not stored.
settings.securityHint: Temporarily locks a user or an IP after several failed logins (local and AD users). With AD it also keeps attempts from locking the domain account.
settings.maxAttemptsPerUserHint: Below the AD account lockout threshold, so DBKeeper stops first.
settings.maxAttemptsPerIpHint: Higher than per user: several people may share the same IP.
settings.cloudSqlHeartbeatMinutesHint: How often "Export in progress…" is written to the log while the operation keeps running in GCP. 0 = disabled.
settings.maxConcurrentDumpsHint: How many dumps run at once on this server; the rest wait in the queue. Cloud SQL exports do not count. Two executions never run at once on the same instance.
settings.mongoPasswordViaConfig: Pass the MongoDB password through a temporary file
settings.mongoPasswordViaConfigHint: mongodump receives it in a private file deleted when it finishes, instead of on the command line, where any user on the server can see it with ps. Requires Database Tools 100.3.0 or later; older versions fall back to the command line with a warning in the log.
settings.defaultKeepLast: Keep the latest N backups per database on disk
settings.defaultKeepLastHint: Applies to events without their own retention (local events and local copies of bucket events). When enabled, extra backups are deleted from disk. Buckets are never touched. 0 = no limit.
settings.diskFreeAlertPercent: Alert if the backup disk drops below (% free)
settings.diskFreeAlertPercentHint: Checks the default local storage disk every 10 minutes. Alerts once and again only after it recovers. 0 = disabled.
settings.staleAlertGraceHours: Alert if no backup after a scheduled run (grace hours)
settings.staleAlertGraceHoursHint: After these hours from each scheduled run, if the event has no successful backup (did not run, has not finished or failed) an alert is sent. An event still queued or running is not considered late. 0 = disabled.
settings.dumpInactivityMinutesHint: A dump stops only if, during this time, the file does not grow and there is no output. A large dump that keeps progressing is never cut, however long it takes.
settings.dumpMaxHoursHint: Safety net: total cap even if it keeps progressing. For SQL Server (the server writes the .bak) it is the only limit.
settings.cloudSqlExportTimeoutHoursHint: Time following the export live. After that it does not fail: it keeps being checked in the background.
settings.cloudSqlVerifyIntervalMinutesHint: How often exports past the active follow-up are checked.
settings.cloudSqlExportMaxHoursHint: After this time the export is marked failed (it may continue in GCP). Must be at least the active follow-up.
settings.scratchDesc: The parallel dump (AlloyDB) creates a NEW disk on every run on the VM where DBKeeper runs, formats and mounts it, dumps the databases, uploads the folders to the bucket and deletes it. Requires the root helper and the sudoers rule (ops/README-scratch.md).
settings.scratchEnabled: Enable the parallel dump with temporary disk
settings.scratchMountPointHint: Absolute path; it must also be allowed in the helper (ALLOWED_MOUNTS). Only one run with a disk at a time.
settings.scratchCredentialDefault: The default GCP credential, or the VM account
settings.scratchCredentialHint: Needs to create, attach, detach and delete disks in the VM project.
settings.scratch_defaultSizeGbHint: Used without history. With history: last backup + margin, never below this value.
settings.scratch_maxSizeGbHint: Cap for the automatic size and for the size set by each event (cost control).
settings.scratch_sizeMarginPctHint: Headroom for database growth between backups.
settings.scratch_gcIntervalMinutesHint: How often to look for temporary disks left alive (crash or restart) to release them.
settings.scratch_uploadConcurrencyHint: Dump files uploaded at the same time. More speeds up the upload but uses more network and memory.

artifacts.copyHint: On-disk copy of a backup uploaded to a bucket; local retention prunes it without touching the bucket object.
